hints.title: Circular Triplet Check
hints.text: For each tile i in a circle of size n, inspect its left neighbor (i - 1 + n) % n and right neighbor (i + 1) % n.

hints.title: Alternation Condition
hints.text: Tile i forms an alternating group of length 3 if colors[i] does not equal colors[(i - 1 + n) % n] and colors[i] does not equal colors[(i + 1) % n].

hints.title: Linear Sweep
hints.text: Count the number of indices satisfying this alternating condition across all i in [0..n - 1].

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of tiles in colors
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan is already minimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use circular modulo indexing cleanly to check local 3-tile alternation.
